matches.description: Watch Charlotte vs Atlas highlights and goals from Leagues Cup on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 8, 2026. The atmosphere was electric as Charlotte FC hosted Seattle Sounders FC on August 8, 2026, in a matchup that promised high-intensity MLS action. Both sides entered the pitch looking to assert dominance in a critical mid-season encounter. Helinho Increases the Advantage Following a tightly contested opening half where both teams struggled to find the final ball, Charlotte FC emerged after the break with renewed vigor. The home side’s persistence paid off in the 64th minute when Helinho stepped up to deliver a moment of clinical brilliance. His goal doubled the lead to 2-0, shifting the momentum firmly in favor of the hosts and forcing Seattle Sounders FC into a more desperate attacking stance. The goal reflected Charlotte's superior ball movement and tactical discipline throughout the second period. Viñas Puts the Game to Bed As the match entered its final stages, Seattle pushed forward in hopes of a late comeback, but the Charlotte defense remained resolute. The home side managed the clock expertly, absorbing pressure before launching a devastating counter-attack in stoppage time. In the 90+3 minute, F. Viñas found the back of the net to make it 3-0, effectively ending any hope for the visitors. The final whistle confirmed a comprehensive performance from Charlotte FC , highlighting their efficiency in front of goal and their ability to close out games under pressure.
